buildEnvironment.comment: astro.config.mjs fixes `base` to "/" for the generated Vercel origin, so preview and production builds use the same public path layout.

sourceGlobNotes.reason: Website-owned pure candidate projection for the selected semantic operations. It emits bounded in-memory path/byte changes only and accepts no caller repository, path, command, provider, domain or approval data.

Defines the `articles` collection: its glob loader and its zod strictObject frontmatter schema. Like src/data/schema.ts it is simultaneously a validator and a build input, so it is bound through renderer_sha256 rather than content_schema_sha256. governance/schemas/article-frontmatter.v1.schema.json is its platform-facing mirror.

Imported by src/lib/media.ts, so it is a build input. Migration provenance, not client copy: it maps WordPress upload URLs to the local copies under public/assets/wp/ that the source globs already cover via public/**.
Imported by both article routes. The only new stylesheet the article surfaces required; src/styles.css remains byte-frozen and untouched.
Already covered public/assets; now also covers public/assets/wp/, the 36 migrated WordPress uploads referenced by article bodies and hero images.

publishedRoutes.comment: The exhaustive route shapes the governed build emits into dist/client — currently 35 HTML pages, four discovery/control endpoints, generated stylesheets and copied assets. Typed page records add one /<slug>/index.html route each. All bytes are renderer-owned and derived from the declared data/content/renderer inputs; there is no separate marketing record or hand-authored output file.

routeNotes.reason: Seven migrated page records are emitted at present; each governed typed_page_create record adds exactly one collision-checked route with the same shape.

One page per published entry in the `articles` content collection — 18 at present. `build.format` is "directory", hence the trailing-slash route. `<slug>` is the frontmatter `slug`, which src/lib/articles.ts requires to equal the filename.
The 36 migrated WordPress uploads, copied from public/assets/wp/ by Astro's publicDir. Referenced by article body images and resolved for share images through src/data/media-manifest.json.

excludedFromRendererSources.reason: Governed content, not renderer source. Bound separately through the candidate manifest's changed_paths, diff_sha256 and content_schema_sha256.
One route per category in the client's enforced article category vocabulary.

Governed content, not renderer source — the eighteen migrated posts. Frontmatter is bound through content_schema_sha256 (governance/schemas/article-frontmatter.v1.schema.json) and the body AST through markdown_policy_sha256 (governance/markdown-policy.v1.json), which now HAS a local binding. Excluded from renderer_sha256 so a copy change and a renderer change can never be confused for one another.

Migration provenance: what the extractor pulled from davetaxnz.nz/wp-json/wp/v2/posts and what it did with each field. Referenced only in a source comment, imported by nothing, and contributes no bytes to dist. Unlike src/data/media-manifest.json it is not a build input, so it is neither a renderer source nor governed content.

Inert pre-Astro React sources. Excluded by tsconfig.json, imported by nothing in the build graph, and retained only as the human reference the Astro components were ported from. They contribute no bytes to dist and must not be treated as renderer inputs.
Repository tooling and documentation. Not read by the build.
Deployment topology, downstream of the renderer. A deployment change does not alter dist and is out of scope for a content candidate.
